NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA软件栈和全栈协同设计打造数据中心级AI基础设施平台
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Build data-center-scale AI infrastructure through CUDA software stack and extreme full-stack co-design
concrete_bets: Full-stack hardware, systems, software and AI models

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过智能云与智能边缘平台，微软将AI贯穿技术栈各层，以Microsoft 365 Copilot和智能体推动负责任的企业级AI普及
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Deliver responsible, full-stack AI via the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge, led by Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents.
concrete_bets: intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将生成式AI集成到Gotham和Foundry中，实现企业与政府领域的AI优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI into Gotham and Foundry via AIP to enable AI advantage across enterprise and government.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动全系应用的内容排序与发现，并通过Meta AI助手与AI眼镜将生成式AI融入社交与硬件体验。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Use AI to power ranking and discovery across apps, and embed Meta AI assistant and AI glasses into social and hardware experiences.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps, web, and AI glasses
AI-powered content ranking and discovery engine
Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses with conversational assistant

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Simon Willison的多篇Datasette/LLM插件发布与SQLite扩展实验，围绕同一数据工具生态。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Simon Willison's Datasette and LLM plugin releases plus SQLite extension experiments share one tooling ecosystem.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Raschka系列课程与文章聚焦推理模型构建、Transformer分类、循环块、水印与文本检测等模型内部机制。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Raschka's course and posts examine reasoning model building, Transformers for classification, looping blocks, watermarking and text detection.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: HuggingFace博文涵盖机器人仿真、语音识别/TTS、世界模拟、文档抽取等开源模型与数据集落地。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: HuggingFace posts cover open models and datasets for robot simulation, ASR/TTS, world simulation and document extraction.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI合作Hacktron找漏洞、GPT-6 Cyber网络安全模型、Merge案例及负责任基础设施政策，聚焦安全与合规落地。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI's Hacktron partnership, GPT-6 Cyber security model, Merge case study and responsible infrastructure policy focus on secure deployment.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI湿实验室基准与Google Research的健康、生物、地球领域智能体应用，同属AI用于科学与医疗场景。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI's wet-lab benchmark plus Google Research health, bio and Earth agent applications all apply AI to science and medicine.
